name: Barbados
about: Dry season Dec–Apr is classic Caribbean winter-sun. Hurricane season runs Jun–Nov, with risk peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: Classic Caribbean winter-sun island, with a distinct British-Caribbean culture, world-class rum, and the flying-fish-and-cou-cou national dish.
costOverview: Barbados sits toward the expensive end of the Caribbean — the national dish, flying fish and cou-cou, costs more than equivalent local food on nearby islands, and a rum tour is the one splurge nearly every visitor builds in.
monthlyWeather: dry and warm, one of the most pleasant months of the year
